description: The new P-Team is the weapon Thomas Frischknecht rode to numerous World Cup wins in the 1990's, only better. Updates include the totally redesigned, heat-treated, triple-butted Logic II steel tubeset, proprietary forged and machined integrated head tube and gram-shaving, chainstay-mounted disc mount that allows the use of lighter seatstays for a little more rough trail compliance. But the key ingredients of the original P-Team's winning formula remains unchanged: the nimble, responsive Ritchey feel, proven 26-inch wheels, and an insatiable desire to win.

components.description: Designed for use with 100mm travel forks
The P-Team uses the Logic Zero WCS drop in 1-1/8” (41.8 Campy)
